Class BuildingEffect

java.lang.Object
mesos.effects.BuildingEffect
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
EndGameScoringEffect, ExtraTopRowPickEffect, NoBuildingEffect, PerCharacterEventBonusEffect, ShamanicRitualEffect, SustenanceDiscountEffect, TriggeredFoodRewardEffect, TurnOrderPlacementEffect
public abstract class BuildingEffect extends Object implements Serializable
Strategy base class for all building card effects. All hook methods are no-ops and all query methods return neutral defaults, so concrete subclasses only need to override what they actually change.
